hypothesis_title: STR_1715 HMM Regime — Hidden Markov Model Latent State (MDD + Vol)
hypothesis_description: STR_1715 PG2 100% live MDD -32.05% gap. 통계적 팩터 only — Hidden Markov Model. Method: market features (return/vol/correlation) on monthly KOSPI200 + STR_1715 NAV → HMM (multivariate Gaussian emissions, 3-state latent {Normal, Caution, Crisis}) → forward-backward Baum-Welch EM estimation → posterior regime probability per month → regime-conditional weight scaling (statistical only, no fixed cash %). Academic anchor: Hamilton (1989) regime-switching + Ang-Bekaert (2002) international regime + Mamon-Elliott (2007) HMM finance.
